summary.name: muCommander
summary.one_liner: muCommander is an open source, dual-pane file manager available on all major operating systems.
use_cases: browse and manage files on local and remote servers
browse and extract archives like ZIP, RAR and 7z
transfer files over FTP, SFTP or SMB
access cloud storage such as Dropbox or Google Drive
summary.what_it_does:
muCommander is a dual-pane file manager that supports copying, moving, renaming, batch renaming and emailing files, with multiple tabs, universal bookmarks and a credentials manager. Its virtual filesystem connects to local volumes, FTP, SFTP, SMB, NFS, HTTP, Amazon S3, Hadoop HDFS and Bonjour, plus Dropbox and Google Drive. It can open and browse archives including ZIP, RAR, 7z, TAR, GZip, BZip2, ISO/NRG and AR/Deb, and it can calculate checksums. The interface, toolbars and themes are customizable, keyboard shortcuts are configurable, and it is available in many languages.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">open source
notable: Dual-pane interface with virtual filesystem for many network protocols
Archive support for many formats including RAR and 7z
Portable zip build for running on any computer
Available as a FreeBSD port and nightly builds on GitHub
caveats: Requires Java 11 or later to run
macOS 10.15 (Catalina) and below must use the noarch dmg build
